page.overview:
What is Life Bond?

Life Bond was a Force power that allowed a Force-user to permanently form a mental link with another person. The Sithspawn Dark Jedi Gorc and Picaroon C.

Boodle possessed a life-bond, allowing them to share senses and granting them limited telepathy, in addition to linking their susceptibility to injury and the Dark side of the Force. Upon Jedi Knight Kyle Katarn's killing of Gorc, Pic's bond sent him into a violent frenzy.
